_comment: Crawler config. Providers: greenhouse, ashby, lever (region: eu), personio, smartrecruiters, teamtailor, workday, rippling, bamboohr, plus the aggregators spacecareers, spacecapital, jobsinphotonics and mycareersfuture (LinkedIn is not crawled; it is only used to find company names). Optional per entry: interval_hours (fetch only when due, 2 to 48; Bavaria, the maintainer's hit-rate leaders and Singapore/UAE boards run every cycle, other regions less often), only_locations (keep only roles whose location contains one of these). Slug is auto-detected from careers_url or set explicitly. Keywords: plain = substring, 'word:' = whole word; accent/case-insensitive. This is the broad filter that decides what is tracked and published; it contains no personal data.
